_meta.purpose: Phase 0 yardstick for the college baseball sim. Every sim run is graded against this file. Do not edit values by feel; change only with a new source and a note in PHASE0_NOTES.md.

confidence_key.A: direct from official/primary source, complete season
confidence_key.B: computed from a primary source table (e.g. mean across conferences)
confidence_key.C: derived from a sample (e.g. one conference) or trend-extrapolated; replace in Phase 1 data pull
confidence_key.D: placeholder estimate; must be replaced before the gate that uses it

league_totals_2025._note: Unweighted mean across all 29 conferences + Oregon State (independent). Weighting by team count will move these slightly; recompute from full team table in Phase 1.

bb_pct.src: WMT stats API box totals, 2259 2025 D1-vs-D1 games (about a quarter of the season), reweighted by tier x opponent-tier cell to the full-season matchup mix; data/ncaa_2025/pbp/schedules (fetched 2026-10-01); team-weighted, matchup-reweighted. Replaces the FanGraphs unweighted conference mean (.1137): WMT and FanGraphs agree conference by conference (SEC .121/.121, ACC .116/.121, Big Ten .114/.117, Big 12 .114/.113, Mountain West .095/.095), so the difference is that P4 conferences walk the most and are a fifth of D1 teams.

league_totals_by_tier_2025._note: Use these when validating a conference-tier subset. P4 = ACC, SEC, Big 12, Big Ten, Oregon State. 'mid' and 'low' are rough groupings, see PHASE0_NOTES.md.

pa_outcome_table_league_avg._note: Per plate appearance, WMT stats API play-by-play, 2232 D1 games / 178073 PA, 2025; data/ncaa_2025/pbp (fetched 2026-10-01), reweighted by batting-tier x pitching-tier cell to the full-season D1 matchup mix. ROE = reached on error, FC = reached on fielder's choice (batter safe, not a hit); FC, SF and SH depend on the base-out state, see _derived.state_dependence. WMT covers about a quarter of the 2025 D1 season and over-represents P4 programs; see PHASE0_NOTES.md.

game_structure.weekend_series: Fri-Sat-Sun 3-game series in conference play; midweek 1-2 non-conference games

extra_innings_freq.src: WMT schedules, 2273 2025 D1 games with innings recorded (about a quarter of the season); data/ncaa_2025/pbp/schedules

run_distribution_per_team_game.src: data.ncaa.com scoreboard JSON, every D1 game day of the season; see data/ncaa_2025/scoreboard/manifest.json
run_distribution_per_team_game.note: Bins are P(0)..P(14), P(15+) per D1 team-game, final games only, run-rule games included as played. margin_10plus is an upper bound on run-rule frequency, not the rate itself.

run_rule_freq.note: P(run rule) = P(final margin >= 10, all 8,079 scoreboard games) x P(game ended before the 9th | margin >= 10, WMT sample). Scheduled 7-inning doubleheaders that also reach a 10-run margin are counted.
run_rule_freq.tol_note: 3 SE of the product estimator (scoreboard share of 10-run margins x WMT conditional share ended early)

roster_rules_2025_26.designated_student_athletes: players rostered 2024-25 or promised a 2025-26 spot are grandfathered and do not count against 34

eligibility.note: COVID extra-year cohort largely expired by 2025

base_running_2025._note: WMT stats API play-by-play, 2232 D1 games / 178073 PA, 2025; data/ncaa_2025/pbp (fetched 2026-10-01). Runner destinations by batter result and starting base, pooled over outs; the full table by outs and base state is data/ncaa_2025/derived/runner_advancement_2025.json. Advancement rates vary little by tier, so these are raw sample values.

league_totals_2025_team_weighted_wmt._note: WMT stats API box totals, 2259 2025 D1-vs-D1 games (about a quarter of the season), reweighted by tier x opponent-tier cell to the full-season matchup mix; data/ncaa_2025/pbp/schedules (fetched 2026-10-01). Cross-check of league_totals_2025 conf B values (unweighted conference means) and of the scoreboard R/G; not used to change any conf A/B value. 'raw' is the WMT sample as is; 'reweighted' weights each tier x opponent-tier cell by its share of all 2025 D1-vs-D1 team-games (scoreboard). Validation: reweighted R/G should sit near the scoreboard's 6.78 for D1-vs-D1 games.

half_inning_2025._note: Phase 1 gate. Runs per half-inning P(0)..P(4), P(5+), big-inning frequency (3+ runs) and PA per half-inning from WMT stats API play-by-play, 2232 D1 games / 178073 PA, 2025; data/ncaa_2025/pbp (fetched 2026-10-01), reweighted by batting-tier x pitching-tier cell to the full-season matchup mix. Tolerances are 3 SE at the effective sample size after reweighting (9954 of 38106 half-innings). Partial half-innings (walk-offs, run-rule endings) are included as played, as the engine counts them.
half_inning_2025.src: WMT stats API play-by-play, 2232 D1 games / 178073 PA, 2025; data/ncaa_2025/pbp (fetched 2026-10-01)

player_talent_2025._note: True-talent distributions on the logit scale, from WMT play-by-play, 2225 games / 177503 PA, 2025 (data/ncaa_2025/pbp, built 2026-10-01). logit rate = logit L + mu_group + T_tier + U_team + e_player. Binomial noise removed by method of moments (observed variance of rate minus tier-cell expectation, less the mean q(1-q)/n); team vs individual split from team means of full-season teams (var_team_mean = var_U + var_e / k_eff). Rates: K, BB, HBP, HR per PA; BABIP = hits / non-HR balls in play excluding reached-on-error; XBH = (2B+3B)/(1B+2B+3B). Pitcher individual XBH is not modeled (hit-type mix attributed to the batter). Since the PR #4 review the league generator uses tier_effects_logit only for the quality directions (P4 minus low contrast) and sd_team_logit only for team style (the part with no run value); tier means, team and conference spreads come from team_talent_2025. Bias: the play-by-play holds only WMT client schools' games; full-season teams are {'p4': 36, 'low': 1, 'mid': 13} by tier against a D1 mix of 21% P4, 50% mid, 29% low, so team-level variances and the individual spreads rest mostly on P4 rosters. Tier effects are fitted from all 9 batting x pitching tier cells, which every tier enters, and are less exposed. Midweek-starter estimates rest on 25 pitchers.

groups_defined.regular: top 9 by PA on the team
groups_defined.sp_weekend: starts in >=50% of appearances, >=50% of starts Fri-Sun
groups_defined.sp_midweek: starts in >=50% of appearances, mostly Mon-Thu

team_strength_2025._note: Every 2025 D1-vs-D1 final in the NCAA scoreboard feed (data/ncaa_2025/scoreboard). Team season runs scored and allowed per game; SDs across teams include each team's game-to-game sampling noise, as the simulated seasons do. Tolerances are 3 SE of the real statistic. Gate for Phase 2.

usage_2025._note: Pitcher and lineup usage from WMT play-by-play, 2225 games / 177503 PA, 2025 (data/ncaa_2025/pbp, built 2026-10-01). Full hazard tables (starter and reliever pull probability by outing pitch count, runs allowed and inning end) and pitches-per-PA distributions are in data/ncaa_2025/derived/phase2_inputs_2025.json.
usage_2025.weekend_start_note: full-season teams; rank = team's k-th most frequent weekend starter, ranks >= 8 pooled; series game = order of the team's Fri-Sun games within the calendar week (third and later pooled)

pitchers_50ip_per_team.note: FanGraphs 882 / 303 teams; WMT full-season teams give 2.90

qualified_players_2025._note: Qualified batters (NCAA rule: 2.0 PA per team game and 75% of team games) and pitchers (1 IP per team game) on WMT full-season teams plus the Sidearm full-season pages, reweighted so each tier counts by its share of D1 teams. Tolerances 3 SE from a team-cluster bootstrap within tier. Conf B: 72% of sample teams are P4 and the low tier rests on few teams, so low-tier tails carry the most uncertainty.

qualification.batter: PA >= 2.0 x team games and games >= 0.75 x team games

sample_tops.note: Maxima of a sample of ~60 teams, not the 303-team population; informational only

leaderboards_2025._note: Full-population extremes for the Phase 2 gate. The sim passes a row if the real value falls inside the central 95% of the simulated seasons. FanGraphs rows are conf A (all D1 pitchers and teams); individual BA and HR tops have no full-population source here (stats.ncaa.org not available), so they are informational.

team_talent_2025._note: Team strength on one talent scale. Quasi-Poisson fit of runs per team-game on team offense o, run prevention d (log runs, centred over teams) and the listed home slot; (o, d) = tier mean + conference effect + team effect. Estimation noise removed by method of moments using each team's covariance from the fit; conference covariance = spread of conference means minus (team + noise)/n, per tier, projected to PSD. Hosting of nonconference games: logistic in tier pair and strength gap, slope disattenuated for noise. Engine mapping (phase2_run_scale_2025.json): o and d become logit offsets along the batting and pitching quality directions scaled so one unit is one log run in the engine; the home talent edge is home_log_ratio minus the engine's batting-last effect h0. NCAA scoreboard feed, every 2025 D1-vs-D1 final (data/ncaa_2025/scoreboard/games_2025.csv; fetched for PR #1)
team_talent_2025.conf_note: Tier means, team covariances and the home effect rest on all 306 D1 teams (conf A). Conference covariances rest on 4 (P4), 15 (mid) and 10 (low) conferences and the hosting model on 3,550 nonconference games (conf B).

tier_matrix_2025._note: NCAA scoreboard feed, every 2025 D1-vs-D1 final (data/ncaa_2025/scoreboard/games_2025.csv; fetched for PR #1). Runs per team-game by batting tier (rows) and pitching tier (columns). Tolerance 3 SE, two-way cluster-robust (batting team, pitching team). Gate for Phase 2.

home_2025._note: NCAA scoreboard feed, every 2025 D1-vs-D1 final (data/ncaa_2025/scoreboard/games_2025.csv; fetched for PR #1). Listed home team (no neutral-site flag in the feed). Tolerance 3 SE, two-way cluster-robust (home team, away team).
